validity_findings.finding: Stratum-size bias decomposition (weighted framework, shuffled-action null, K2 records, 100 shuffles) recomputed from raw_exploratory.json: mean null per-stratum PMI +0.74235 bits (median 0.72193) for strata size 5-9 (n_obs 31300), +0.57120 (median 0.56096) for 10-19 (8000), +0.37869 (median 0.36169) for 20-49 (500). Monotonically decreasing in stratum size, confirming per-stratum plug-in PMI small-sample bias is largest in small strata. This falsifies prereg H1 mechanistic hypothesis (bias from large-stratum dominance) and explains why equal-weight (0.704) and median (0.686) worsen aggregate bias vs weighted (0.407): they up-weight the most biased small strata. Bias pervasive across stochastic strata, not limited to deterministic strata.

N=50000 descriptive context (non-gating per frozen PHASE 2 applicability) shows no estimator converges within 0.2-bit C4 band: weighted K2 diff +0.845482 (1.778725 vs 0.933244), equal-weight +0.247207 (1.737681 vs 1.490475), median +0.372559 (1.883523 vs 1.510964), KNN +1.260657 (1.284007 vs 0.023350). K3 drifts similarly +0.305, +0.096, +0.057, +0.599 bits. All four exceed 0.2 threshold; KNN drift >1 bit demonstrates KNN estimator instability with sample size on this SPA due to neighborhood density change. Producer correctly marks C4 NOT_APPLICABLE and uses N50000 descriptively to document convergence impossibility, not to gate verdict. Supports environment-level bias interpretation and replicates parent exploratory N50000 weighted K2 1.778725 exactly.

validity_findings.finding: Frozen spec declares shuffled-action null threshold |mean|<0.1 but does not pin K2 vs K3 condition; null_control_permutation correctly notes 'condition K2 records (state-history K=2), parent precedent'. Producer discloses choice in validity_notes[2] and uses K2 parent-aligned. If K3 action-history null had been used, bias would be similar or larger due to even smaller strata and greater fragmentation (K3 has 821 vs K2 1292 strata, smaller average n_h), so verdict FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING would not change. No selective reporting; disclosure adequate and margins make choice immaterial.

12-state SHA256 hash-routed SPA transition choose_next(current,action,prev1,prev2)=CANDIDATES[current][action][hash(prev1:prev2:current:action)%4] explicitly depends on 2-step history by construction, so beyond-Markov structure exists by design; environment CAN express K3>K2 for a valid estimator. Negative result is therefore estimator limitation, not environment ceiling (unlike deterministic FSM with H(S_next|URL,H_K=3)=0). However, stratum-size decomposition shows plug-in bias persists in stochastic strata (+0.742 at size 5-9 even when stochastic), so producer unresolved correctly notes that SPA redesign to 0% deterministic may NOT eliminate bias. Physics identifiability requirement fails: weighted/equal/median/KNN estimators do not converge to true conditional mutual information (N=50000 drift, null floors). Correct verdict is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for estimator-level-fix hypothesis, not global C-WEB-DYNAMICS falsification; unfolds to MEASUREMENT_INVALID for unbiased CMI.

claim_ceiling: FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (estimator-level fix insufficient; environment-level bias): None of the three bias-corrected estimators (equal-weight PMI, median PMI, KNN CMI k=5 alpha=1.0) nor the weighted baseline centers the shuffled-action permutation null below |mean|<0.1 bits at N=5000 on the 12-state SHA256 hash-routed SPA (SEED=42, 50 sessions x100 steps, 1292 K2 strata 398 used, 821 K3 strata 510 used). Observed |null_mean| 0.407 (weighted), 0.704 (equal-weight), 0.686 (median), 0.262 (KNN) bits, each 2.6-7.0x threshold and 35-56 sigma from threshold, with positive controls passing (K3 1.81/1.81/1.87/1.19 >=1.0 p=0.000999). The bias is intrinsic to per-stratum plug-in PMI: small strata (size 5-9) have mean null PMI +0.742 bits vs +0.379 for size 20-49, so equal-weight/median up-weighting amplifies bias and cannot rescue it. KNN shows negative bias -0.262 bits (Laplace smoothing + extra dimension). No K3-K2 inference is justified: descriptive K3-K2 -0.044 to +0.287 at N5000 is estimator-dependent and uninterpretable without valid null; bootstrap/CI not applicable (no C1 passer). No estimator is convergent: |K2(N50000)-K2(N5000)| +0.247 to +1.261 bits >0.2 for all, with KNN worst. Bound strictly to in-memory SPA simulation with hash-routed 4-action candidates; no inference to production SPAs, browser-collected data, real Web dynamics, or other estimators (KSG, Bayesian, likelihood-ratio) which remain untested per do_not_assume. SPA redesign to 0% deterministic strata may NOT eliminate bias because bias persists in stochastic strata (producer unresolved). Determinism correction: K2 det_ratio 0.315, K3 det_ratio 0.108 (not 0.569).
